locator.title: Брать ипотеку в II половине 2026 года? Отвечают эксперты
locator.lead: Кому лучше купить недвижимость сейчас, а кому есть смысл подождать
locator.caption: Чаще всего ипотеку оформляют в Москве и Московской области. В феврале 2026 года спрос на том же уровне, что и в том же месяце прошлого года

nearest_text_before.text: Что касается 2026 года, в феврале средневзвешенная ставка по ипотеке составила 10% — это ещё ниже, чем в 2025 году. Тем не менее, цены на недвижимость продолжат расти. Именно поэтому тем, кто хочет приобрести собственную квартиру, стоит купить недвижимость в ближайшее время.

image_reading: A static horizontal grouped bar chart compares mortgage issuance volumes across ten Russian regions for February 2026, January 2026, and February 2025.
The February 2026 series is blue and has exact numeric labels; Moscow has the longest bars, followed by the Moscow region and Saint Petersburg.
The chart’s meaning depends on legible Russian text, exact numbers, colors, ordering, and bar geometry; there is no natural physical motion or scene depth.
analysis.article_context: The body chart supports the article’s claim that mortgage issuance is concentrated in Moscow and the Moscow region, while February 2026 demand remains broadly comparable with February 2025. Its exact regional labels, values, series colors, and relative bar lengths carry the editorial evidence.

structured_intent.editorial_meaning: Emphasize the geographic concentration of mortgage issuance in Moscow and the Moscow region and the February 2026 comparison presented as evidence in the article.
structured_intent.initial_state: A fully static grouped horizontal bar chart with ten regional rows, three color-coded series, exact labels and values, and no active highlight.
structured_intent.motion_owner: The visible blue February 2026 bar series.
structured_intent.primary_action: Receives one contained optical emphasis that travels across the existing blue bar boundaries without modifying the chart.
structured_intent.terminal_state: The optical emphasis has faded and the complete chart remains visually identical, fully legible, and unobscured.
structured_intent.geometry_invariant: All bars retain their exact lengths, alignment, spacing, ordering, and positions relative to labels and gridlines.
structured_intent.identity_invariant: All ten regions, three series, numeric labels, legend entries, title glyphs, and chart marks remain present and unchanged.
structured_intent.semantic_invariant: The displayed values, ranking of regions, month-to-month comparison, and prominence of Moscow and the Moscow region remain exactly unchanged.
structured_intent.feasibility_assessment: The chart, its series, ordering, and exact values are clearly visible, but it contains no source-grounded natural motion or physical depth. Generative animation could corrupt semantically essential text, numbers, colors, or bar geometry, so only a contained deterministic optical accent is safe.

models.scene_plan: Over five seconds, keep the source chart completely fixed and apply one low-opacity highlight pulse contained within the existing blue February 2026 bars. Let the accent progress once from the Moscow row downward through the remaining blue bars, then fade by the final frames, leaving every source pixel, label, number, bar length, color, and layout unchanged.

For the five-second composition, preserve the chart at its original framing and pass one thin, subdued glint across the blue February 2026 series, moving from the top-ranked region toward the bottom-ranked region at an even pace. Confine the effect to the existing blue bar boundaries and dissolve it near the end so the final frame reproduces the unchanged chart.
